methodology.batch_note: Batch 2 retains all ten batch-1 hypotheses and adds six fixed models after reviewing batch-1 results. All periods remain discovery. Family correction covers all models in this run.

bootstrap.method: common-index circular block bootstrap confidence intervals; centered max-t familywise p for this batch

methodology.data_exclusion_note: 2018-02-08 Binance daily candle has a short close timestamp (1518049694788), so the new contiguous episode starts 2018-02-10. No OHLC/volume filling.

equal_weight_20.description: Daily rebalanced equal-weight 20% exposure baseline; not buy-and-hold.

sma200_trend.description: Each asset gets its equal 20% portfolio sleeve while close exceeds SMA200; inactive sleeves stay cash.

momentum_vote.description: Equal asset sleeves multiplied by fraction of positive 21/63/126-day close-to-close momentum votes.

inverse_vol_trend.description: Allocate 20% among close>SMA200 and SMA50>SMA200 assets in inverse 30-day realized volatility proportions.

dual_momentum_rotation.description: Every UTC-epoch-anchored seventh day select highest mean 63/126-day momentum asset if positive and close>SMA200; exit daily on loss of either gate.

adaptive_efficiency_trend.description: Equal sleeves when close>KAMA20, close>SMA200 and 20-day efficiency ratio>=0.25; KAMA uses fast2/slow30 smoothing.

rsi2_trend_dip.description: Equal sleeve enters below RSI2=10 with close>SMA200; exit above RSI2=60, loss of SMA200, or five completed holding days. No same-day reentry.

daily_breakout_ensemble.description: Two half-sleeves per asset: close above prior 20/55 daily highs enters; close below prior 10/20 daily lows exits. Levels exclude signal bar.

volatility_scaled_momentum.description: Momentum-vote sleeves scaled by min(1,35% / annualized trailing 30-day daily-return volatility); never increases leverage.

online_logistic_momentum.description: Online per-asset logistic classifier of next-open to following-open positive return; matured labels only, fixed clipped features, one gradient update per observation. Equal sleeve requires probability>0.55 and close>SMA200.

pooled_ridge_7d.description: Monthly pooled cross-asset ridge forecasts next-open to seven-days-later-open simple return. Equal sleeve is active when forecast exceeds 64bps. Matured labels only.

parameters.retrain: first available decision and first UTC calendar day of each new month
parameters.scaling: feature means/std computed from that training window only

pooled_ridge_21d.description: Same fixed pooled ridge specification with a 21-day next-open holding-return label and 64bps entry hurdle.

parameters.retrain: first available decision and first UTC calendar day of each new month
parameters.scaling: feature means/std computed from that training window only

btc_regime_equal.description: Equal 20% aggregate asset sleeves only when BTC close>SMA200, SMA50>SMA200, and 63-day momentum>0; otherwise cash.

btc_regime_inverse_vol.description: Same BTC regime gate; active assets share 20% in inverse trailing 30-day daily-return volatility proportions.

online_expert_cash_blend.description: Exponentially weighted 63-day momentum, 126-day momentum, 55/20-day breakout and cash experts. Scores update only on matured next-open returns, charging modeled 16bps one-way turnover; 126-day exponential forgetting and learning rate 10. Four experts start equal.

conservative_horizon_blend.description: Equal blend of fixed 63-day momentum, 126-day momentum and 55/20-day breakout experts; each expert has equal asset sleeves and at most 20% aggregate exposure.

limitations_hu: Feltáró, visszatekintő kutatás; nem érintetlen holdout és nem jövőbeli forward teszt.
Az USDT és USDC epizód külön induló tőkét használ; hozamuk nem adható össze és nem láncolható egy számlává.
A drawdown napi záróértékekből számolt, ezért a napon belüli visszaesést alulbecsülheti.
A célallokáció nem veszteséglimit; az árfolyammozgás a tényleges kitettséget a cél fölé viheti.
A költségek és mennyiségi limitek szimulációs feltételezések, nem rekonstruált historikus ajánlati könyv vagy tőzsdei limitek.
A blokk-bootstrap állandó eloszlást közelít; a családonkénti korrekció csak erre a stratégiakészletre vonatkozik, nem a teljes korábbi kutatásra.
A walk-forward eredmény a teljes készlet kiválasztási szabályáé, nem az egyes stratégiák önálló teljesítménye.
Egy átmenő eredmény is csak előzetes historikus jelölt: a konzisztens nyereséghez új, előre rögzített forward bizonyíték szükséges.
